Section 2.03 (b) | Description :The Guarantor specifically undertakes totransfer to the Borrower no less than 20 per cent of the total excise tax on oil derivatives, collected within each calendarquarter; transfers shall be made on a regular basis, but at least four times a year, in intervals not exceeding three calendarmonths, and as needed to guarantee performance of all the Borrower's obligations set forth in the LA. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Loan Agreement, Schedule 2, Section V.1.(a) | Description :Except as the Bank shall otherwise agree, beginningMarch 31,2015, the Borrower shall not incur any debt unless a reasonable revenues and expenditures forecast shows Borrower'sestimated net revenues for each fiscal year during the term of the debt to be incurred shall be at least 1.2 times the Borrower'sestimated debt service requirements in such year on all debt including debt to be incurred | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Loan Agreement, Schedule 2, Section V.2.(a) | Description :Except as the Bank shall otherwise agree, beginningMarch 31, 2015, the Borrower shall maintain a ratio of current assets to current liabilities of not less than 1 (one). | Frequency:CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Loan Agreement, Schedule 2, Section V.2.(b) | Description :Before June 30 in each of its fiscal years, theBorrower shall, on the basis of forecasts prepared by the Borrower and satisfactory to the Bank, review whether it would meet therequirements set forth in paragraph (a) in respect of such year and the next following fiscal year and shall furnish to the Bankthe results of such review upon its completion. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :Loan Agreement, Schedule 2, Section V.2.(c) | Description :If any such review shows that the Borrower would notmeet the requirements set forth in paragraph (a) for the Borrower's fiscal years covered by such review, the Borrower shallpromptlytake all necessary measures (including, without limitation, adjustments of the structure or levels of its rates) in orderto meet such requirements. | Frequency :Yearly

Citizen Input to PESR during preparation and construction of the project.

actual.value: Citizens' inputs on over- & underpasses are included in the design. A grievance Redress Mechanism exists. Given that the main concern has been addressed, the interchange was included in the design and it is being built the committees have completed their main responsibility. Their function is mostly on facilitating day-to-day communication if needed.

title.narrative: Citizen Input to PESR during preparation and construction of the project.

actual.value: The project related Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM) has been very efficient in both lots. The complaint committee established by the Local Government in Rankovce has been facilitating the interaction between the PESR, Supervising Engineers (SE), Contractors and the communities affected by the civile works executed under the project. Since Lot 1 construction works are still ongoing, various issues have been raised by the local communities with respect to access/local roads and the Contractor addressed or is in process of addressing them. The most recent ones are related to the construction of two new interchanges and to the completion of the construction of the road from the settlement of Ljubince to the Cemetery of the village of Ljubince. All the grievances and how they were addressed have been recorded in the grievance logbook.
